description: Split shared costs equally between housemates, compare with what each already paid, and compute balances plus the fewest payments that settle everyone. Use after people fronted money for the group. Computes only; moves no money. Do NOT use for usage-weighted bills (use split_utilities).

costs.description: Shared costs, split equally between everyone in payments (names must be unique), e.g. [{"name":"Groceries","amount":140}]

payments.description: Every housemate sharing the costs and what they already paid (include people who paid 0), e.g. [{"name":"Asha","paid":150},{"name":"Mira","paid":0}]

paid.description: Amount this housemate already paid towards the costs, 0 or more

name: settle_up

note.description: Summary of how many payments settle the group

balance.description: paid minus owed; positive = should receive money, negative = owes money

owed.description: Equal share of the total costs

transfers.description: Fewest payments that settle all balances (empty when settled)

title: Settle up
